verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing copy about gaming, creative apps, and AI features plus generic developer-tool blurbs (oneDNN, VTune) — nothing documents core/thread counts, boost clocks, or independent multi-core compilation/parallel-job benchmarks for the 258V. missing for 10: documented core/thread counts and boost clock specs, independent multi-core benchmark results (e.g. Cinebench, compile-time tests), any developer-reported build performance data.
